'''Gorr-Bon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] who served in the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. [[Mirith Sinn]] used his impressive body to impress and terrify a captured [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent during an interrogation.
